title: Beautiful Images, Toxic Words: Understanding and Addressing Offensive Text in Generated Images

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the visual generation of NSFW text, including slurs, hate speech, and profanity, by extracting text from generated images via OCR and comparing it to target toxic words using the custom ToxicBench benchmark, text-based toxicity classifiers, and character-level metrics like NGram Levenshtein Distance.
